name: GET /api/leadflow/offers/current - the only version a rep may quote
description:
Returns the APPROVED ACTIVE version of an offer and nothing else (92ce5959-0e5c-4ce8-be7a-02cc870b2120#AC1). Improvisation is made structurally impossible rather than discouraged: a rep who cannot see last quarter's pricing cannot quote it by accident, and one who cannot see an unapproved draft cannot quote terms nobody reviewed. A partial unique index enforces one active version per offer, because two would mean two reps quoting different terms and both believing they were current.

AN ABSENT ACTIVE VERSION IS A 404, NOT AN EMPTY 200. A rep handed nothing would improvise, which is the exact failure this endpoint prevents, so the refusal says why: nothing may be quoted until a version is published and activated.

EVERY COMMERCIAL FIELD SOP §12 REQUIRES IS REPORTED RATHER THAN ASSUMED PRESENT (92ce5959-0e5c-4ce8-be7a-02cc870b2120#AC4) - price, quantity basis, payment options, licence limits, implementation expectations, refund and cancellation terms, included features, variable charges and third-party charges. The ten columns are NOT NULL in the schema, and missing_required_fields is returned alongside so a caller can see the sheet is complete rather than trusting that it is.

THE APPROVAL ROUTE IS RETURNED WITH THE VERSION (92ce5959-0e5c-4ce8-be7a-02cc870b2120#AC2): leadership, legal and finance, with approval_complete as their conjunction. A CHECK constraint refuses activation without approval, so an unapproved sheet is unquotable rather than merely unmarked - activating one would put unreviewed terms in front of a buyer.

version_stamp is the string a checkout link and a quote carry, so a later dispute about terms is settleable. QA: depends on the offer drafted, approved and activated earlier in the chain; offer_key is read from the cache.

testCases.name: The active approved version is returned with its approval route and required-field check
NEGATIVE: an offer with no approved active version is refused rather than returned empty
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.when: the offer_key query parameter is absent or empty.

errorCases.message: No approved active version exists for that offer. Nothing may be quoted until one is published and activated.
errorCases.when: the offer has no version that is both approved and active - the refusal is deliberate, because a rep handed nothing would improvise.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
